Musica, chat IA, dadi, tech news e offerte.

**/language** · **/stats** · **/updates**
help.music.title: 🎵 Musica
help.music.body:
`/play` — musica in voce · `/skip` — salta brano · `/pause` — pausa · `/resume` — riprendi

`/queue` — coda + in riproduzione · `/shuffle` — mescola · `/loop` — loop · `/replay` — riavvia brano

`/random` — hit casuale (10k) · `/autoplay` — autoplay · `/lyrics` — testo · `/seek` — +30 / -15

`/volume` — volume stream (t!v) · `/clear` — stop & esci · `/nonstop` — 24/7 · `/clip` — ultimi 30s · `/playlist` — playlist
help.chat.title: 💬 Chat e IA
help.chat.body:
`/chat` — domande IA (immagini OK)

`/roleplay` (t!rp) — chat casual · `t!rp config` — personalità

`/game` — giochi (Steam/Epic)

`/summary` (t!su) — riassunto link
help.dice.title: 🎲 Dadi
help.dice.body:
`d20` · `4d6` · `2d10+5` · `c50+50`

`adv` · `dis` · `stats` · `coin`

`t!d adv` · `t!d stats` · `t!d macro add <nome> <expr>`

Senza prefisso in chat — pulsante reroll incluso.
